## Thesis

The Vault Manager Basket is strategically positioned to capitalize on market momentum and volume, focusing on long positions in high-volume futures such as the E-Mini S&P 500 and Micro E-Mini S&P 500. The strategy aims to optimize returns by dynamically allocating capital to perp positions, ensuring a balanced approach that leverages market trends while maintaining sufficient collateral.
